events.title: Annual Community Outreach Fall Festival
events.text: Greater St. Paul’s annual Community Outreach Fall Festival. Saturday, October 24, 2026, 12–3 PM. Family activities include a gaming truck, hot dogs, chips, popcorn and group games. The church flyer invites guests to wear a creative costume. Admission cost is not specified on the flyer; confirm with the church.
